sources.label: Morphe android app patches (for apps that I use) - stable releases
sources.author: bearinmind
patch_list: Brings back the setting to hide the scroll bar.
Removes the update red dot from the menu and Settings.
Solid address and bottom bars instead of the blurred gradient.
Stops Samsung's usage logs, analytics, crash reports and autofill crowdsourcing.
The page's theme color also colors the bottom address bar and bottom bar.
